g.title: our action fetch_lib — a package of this name and version is installable here
our action fetch_lib — the package's payload is on disk where it claims
our action fetch_lib — the package ships the headers it claims
packager (we run nothing here) — the capability file describes the payload beside it — and nothing we run reads it
our action build_lib — this source produced this library
our action build_headers — the public headers are where the build puts them
our action install_lib — what survived being copied out of the build tree
depext table (we run nothing here) — this virtual capability corresponds to THAT system package — a hand-maintained mapping, reviewed rather than computed
our action fetch_binding — the binding package's declared constraint on the bridge is satisfiable
our action fetch_binding — something on this system answers the capability query — THE DIAGONAL, and the one place the symbolic path touches reality
pkg-config (we run nothing here) — the capability query resolves to THIS library on disk — which may not be the one the world provisioned
our action fetch_binding — the whole dependency set is simultaneously satisfiable
our action fetch_binding — the package put its artifacts in the store — the FETCHED direction of the one edge that runs both ways
our action fetch_binding — the user-facing surface is installed as the package claims
our action build_binding — the shim's types agree with the header — everything ABOVE the types it did not establish
our action build_binding — the shim's types agree with the header — everything ABOVE the types it did not establish
our action build_binding — every symbol the stub requires was resolved
our action build_binding — every symbol the stub requires was resolved
our action pack_binding — a package was assembled from what was built — the BUILT direction of the same edge, and a different relation entirely
the library exists and exports something — STATIC: nothing here loads it
our action probe_binding — it linked, loaded and ran when we named every input ourselves
our action probe_binding — it linked, loaded and ran when we named every input ourselves
our action probe_binding — naming only the package was enough to build and run the same program: the recipe resolves to everything the code needs
the claim package_resolution_suffices — the same source, resolved through the package instead of by hand, does the same thing

svg.text: PM LAYER — who resolves and installs
PACKAGE LAYER — symbolic claims, and the bridge between them
ARTIFACT LAYER — what is actually on disk
PROGRAM — the only band where anything runs

g.title: apt, brew, dnf — resolves and installs native packages
the unit the system PM ships: payload plus metadata
the library's own repository at a ref — present when the world builds rather than fetches
the syntactic native surface a binding compiles against
the link-time and runtime carrier: exported symbols, identity, recorded dependencies
DECLARED by the experiment: the c_api's exported functions, the soname, and the symbol-version tags — read by declared_symbols_exported, soname_matches_declaration and declared_versions_exported
the install-prefix face of the same library — a second copy, which is why a claim can compare them

a .pc file, a CMake config, a *-config script: content inside the provider, owned by the package that ships it, recording how the artifacts beside it are built against. Not a bridge — a source of claims, and what a conf package's check reads
a separate package existing only for cooperation (opam's conf-*). Carries package IDENTITY and the depext mapping. THE SYMBOLIC BRIDGE
opam, pip, cargo — solves constraints and installs
the unit the language PM ships, with its declared depends
the binding's own repository — separate from the library's, and often at a different ref
the C shim the binding compiles: what records the symbols it requires of the library
the compiled language-side artifact the consumer links
the names and types the binding offers its own users
DECLARED by the experiment: the watchlist of names the binding must offer — read by api_names_present
every input named by path — the language module and the native library. Says the CODE is right
names only the binding package and lets the PM resolve the rest. Says the RECIPE is right — which is the half a build-tree probe cannot see
